title: Source-balanced Capped Fisher: Bounded Evidence Aggregation for User Inference in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.07228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User inference asks whether a source contributed documents to a language-model update, even when the auditor observes only fresh documents from that source. Document-level scores can provide evidence of participation, but combining this evidence is challenging: documents differ in baseline predictability and in how strongly they reflect information learned from other documents of the same source. We propose source-balanced capped Fisher (SCF), an aggregation method that uses known nonparticipating sources to assess how unusual each document score is. It transforms the resulting reference-tail frequencies into negative-log evidence, caps individual contributions, and averages them within each source. This limits the influence of isolated extreme scores while retaining evidence across multiple documents. We complete the inference procedure with a decision rule that tests source participation using a p-value calibrated against a separate se

translated_title: 源平衡截断Fisher：语言模型中用户推断的有界证据聚合
translated_abstract: 用户推断旨在判断某个来源是否向语言模型的更新贡献了文档，即使审计者仅能观察到该来源的新发布的文档。文档级评分可以提供参与的证据，但如何合并这些证据是一个挑战：不同文档在基线可预测性上存在差异，且它们反映从同一来源其他文档中所学信息的强度也不相同。我们提出源平衡截断Fisher（SCF），一种聚合方法，利用已知的未参与来源来评估每个文档评分的异常程度。该方法将所得的参考尾部频率转换为负对数证据，为单个贡献设置上限，并在每个来源内部进行平均。这限制了孤立极端评分的影响，同时保留了跨多个文档的证据。我们通过一个决策规则完成推断流程，该规则使用针对单独一组来源校准的p值来检验来源是否参与。
tldr: 提出源平衡截断Fisher（SCF）聚合方法，利用已知未参与来源评估文档评分的异常程度，通过为单个贡献设置上限并按来源内部平均，在语言模型用户推断中实现有界的证据聚合。
en_tdlr: Proposes source-balanced capped Fisher (SCF), an aggregation method that uses known nonparticipating sources to assess the unusualness of document scores, capping individual contributions and averaging within each source to achieve bounded evidence aggregation for user inference in language models.
